remarks: Wonderful 3bd 2.5 ba townhouse with hardwood floors throughout. Eat in kitchen with SS appliances. Combined living room/dining room with a gas fireplace and slider that opens up to a stone patio. Walking distance to New Canaan's fine shops, restaurants and train. Complex of 4 townhouses. Professional landlord maintains exterior of complex. 4 hr notice needed for appointment, must be confirmed. Cars must fit in garage. two cars only per unit. No pets of any type allowed. 8/15/2024 occupancy.
